metadata.question: Was there an active fire present near Paradise, California between November 7, 2018 to November 10, 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Collection = FIRMS active-fire (MODIS C6.1 or VIIRS), Date = 2018-11-07 to 2018-11-10, Location ≈ Paradise, CA (lat 39.76, lon –121.62). 2. Masking: FIRMS fire pixels are already classified; no cloud mask needed. 3. Logic: If any image in the interval has ≥1 fire pixel inside a 10-km buffer → A (Yes); else if collection size == 0 → C1; if after clipping pixel count == 0 → C2; if reducer result is None/NaN → C3. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time paradise = ee.Geometry.Point(-121.62, 39.76).buffer(10000) # 10 km start, end = '2018-11-07', '2018-11-10' # 2. Data acquisition fires = ee.ImageCollection('FIRMS').filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(paradise) count_imgs = fires.size().getInfo() print(f"Images: {count_imgs}") if count_imgs == 0: print("C1") # 3. Count fire pixels fire any = fires.map(lambda img: img.gt(0)) # any confidence >0 tot_pix = fire_any.sum().reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=paradise, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('conf').getInfo() if tot_pix is None or tot_pix == 0: print("C2") else: print(f"Fire pixels: {int(tot_pix)}") print("A") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
paradise = ee.Geometry.Point(-121.62, 39.76).buffer(10000)  # 10 km
start, end = '2018-11-07', '2018-11-10'

# 2. Data acquisition
fires = ee.ImageCollection('FIRMS').filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(paradise)
count_imgs = fires.size().getInfo()
print(f"Images: {count_imgs}")
if count_imgs == 0:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

# 3. Count fire pixels
fire any = fires.map(lambda img: img.gt(0))  # any confidence >0
tot_pix = fire_any.sum().reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
    geometry=paradise,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('conf').getInfo()

if tot_pix is None or tot_pix == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
else:
    print(f"Fire pixels: {int(tot_pix)}")
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
